question: What is HubSpot worth per share, and how does that compare with today's share price?

pinned.units: shares in millions; cash and debt in USD millions; price in USD per share
pinned.fcf_definition: FCF = operating cash flow - capex - capitalized software (before restructuring add-back); FCF after SBC = FCF - stock-based compensation

price.source: NYSE close; Yahoo Finance chart API and stockanalysis.com

discount_rate.source: CAPM: 10y UST 5.24% (Treasury.gov, 9 Oct 2026) + beta 1.25 (Damodaran software, Jan 2026) x ERP 4.20% (Damodaran implied, 1 Oct 2026)

terminal_growth.source: cap = FOMC SEP 16 Sep 2026 longer-run real GDP 2.0% + PCE inflation 2.0%

pinned.ev_convention: EV = price x diluted shares + debt - cash; announced restructuring cost excluded

peer_margins.definition: latest fiscal-year FCF after SBC / revenue, from 10-K
